_generate-project-manifest.//: Scans src/, tests/, and examples/ to produce a CSV manifest mapping each assembly name to its ProjectType (Library | LibraryTest | IntegrationTest | Example) and Subgroup (Core | Extensions | Misc | empty). Used by ClassifyCoverageStep to classify TestProject columns and filter SrcPackage rows.

_generate-src-inventory.//: Walks src/**/*.cs and emits a CSV inventory of every source file (AssemblyName, RelativePath, TotalLines). Used by BuildProvenanceIcicleStep as a denominator fallback so src projects whose test project produced no Cobertura output still appear in the report (as 0%-coverage rows).

_stage-coverage-xml.//: Copies the most-recent coverage.cobertura.xml from each test project into the raw datasets directory, named {ProjectName}.xml. Covers both standard test projects (tests/core|extensions|misc|integration) and per-example runs produced by Flowthru.Tests.Examples:test:all (TestResults/{ExampleName}/{guid}/).

run.//: Stages coverage XMLs, runs the Coverage pipeline, then generates the HTML heatmap report.

run:with-tests.//: Stages coverage XMLs, runs the Coverage pipeline, then generates the HTML heatmap report.

run:with-tests-and-purge.//: Stages coverage XMLs, runs the Coverage pipeline, then generates the HTML heatmap report.
